name: The Symbol of Life
label: Quest
description: The Symbol of Life: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Make haste, friend, more than one life hangs in the balance if you fail.
If for some reason you fail to help Gazin and Henze, then return to me and I will give you another Symbol of Life for your travels.
Don't mistake my aid as simple charity, you must prove yourself worthy like any other adventurer and continual failure may reflect upon you later.
